spa_for_eng: lo rápido que = "how quickly": adverbial lo + adj + que modifies the action, invariable
lo rápido que = "how quickly": adverbial, invariable
lo suficientemente rápido = "quickly enough": adverb, invariable
hablando lo suficientemente rápido = "speaking quickly enough": adverb, invariable
Solo quiero = "I just want": solo is the adverb "only/just" (RAE: sólo/solo adverbio), never agrees
Solo un poco = "just a little": adverb; male reading "Sola un poco" was also wrong
no me habría atrevido: participle in a compound tense with haber is invariable; male reading "atrevida" was also wrong
por_for_eng: Portuguese contente is a two-gender adjective (o/a contente); "contenta" is not standard
contente com: contente is invariable for gender
